title: Full faithfulness of principal-quotient restriction on the punctured completion
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of depth at least three [def-weil-pbc-depth], f an element of its maximal ideal, and U the open complement of the closed point in Spec A [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Put C equal to the maximal-ideal completion of A [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], c:Spec C→Spec A, W=c⁻¹(U), g the image of f in C, j:Spec(C/(g))→Spec C, and W₀=j⁻¹(W). Base change along W₀→W defines a fully faithful functor between the categories of finite etale covers [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism], whose morphisms are maps commuting with the structure maps and whose base change is the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product].

source.place: Tag 0BM6; Tag 0BLS, complete-case comparison paragraph; Tags 0AVY, 0ALZ and 0ALJ

proof.text: The completion C is Noetherian, local and flat over A, by AdicCompletion.isNoetherianRing and Mathlib completion instances. Flat local base change preserves regular sequences in the maximal ideal, so depth C is at least depth A. The maximal ideal of C is the extension of that of A; hence precisely its closed point lies over the closed point of A and W is its puncture.

The depth-two puncture lemma makes W connected and its principal slice nonempty. Choose a geometric point on that slice. Equality after pullback gives equality on the corresponding geometric fibre, so faithfulness of the fibre functor for finite etale covers of connected W makes pullback injective on Hom sets.

Given a morphism on the principal slice, finiteEtale_adic_unique_lift lifts it uniquely to every nilpotent thickening. Uniqueness makes these lifts compatible. Apply scalar formal sections comparison, and then finiteEtale_adic_sections_comparison_of_structureSheaf to the finite etale source cover. This uniquely algebraizes the induced compatible ring maps on global sections. The quasi-affine relative toSpecGamma pullback converts the resulting ring map into a scheme morphism over W. The two pullback projection equations verify that its restriction is the prescribed morphism.

The pullback functor is bijective on all Hom sets by the preceding injectivity and surjectivity. Apply Functor.FullyFaithful.nonempty_iff_map_bijective to construct the required Nonempty FullyFaithful.

lean.statement:
theorem fullyFaithful_completed_punctured_quotient
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (f : A) (hf : f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hdepth : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens)
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) :
    let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let c := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A C))
    let W := c ⁻¹ᵁ U
    let j := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {algebraMap A C f})))
    Nonempty (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale) ⊤
      (j ∣_ W)).FullyFaithful
